versions.changelog:
Initial release of vibepolish skill.

- Enables opening HTML demos or static HTML/CSS/JS projects in a VibePolish workbench for WYSIWYG editing and export.
- Distinguishes between single-file and project workflows based on dependencies and file references.
- Runs a single launcher command appropriate for the project type.
- Keeps the connected Chrome session active, reporting CDP and project ports if available.
- Avoids modifying source files, generating previews, or running extra validations unless explicitly requested.
